product.title: Private Big Island Experience: 3 of 4 Window Seats

description.text: This comprehensive helicopter tour of the Big Island treats you like a VIP. Take your Hawaii adventure to the skies, departing from Kona International Airport. Stops include Mauna Kea, Mauna Loa, Kilauea Volcano. Your pilot narrates the terrain below, including valleys, waterfalls, coastline, and—of course—an active volcano. Ideal for visitors touring Hawaii Volcanoes National Park who want a guided Big Island experience without coordinating transport, gear, or park logistics on their own.
